'''2021 World Championship''' was the Players Committee World Championship in Arlington, Virginia (Washington, D.C.), 7–10 October 2021. [[Joe Olson]] defeated [[Matt Scott]] in the Final Confrontation.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2021-world-championships/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' Arlington, Virginia (Washington, D.C.)
* '''Dates:''' 7–10 October 2021
* '''GEMP importable decks:''' [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewforum.php?f=1240 forum]
